methodologyNote: Measured via search referrals in tracked traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Google led search engines in South Africa at 92.95% (market share of tracked page views / usage). bing ranked second at 6.21%, followed by Petal Search at 0.29%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engines in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Google leads at 92.95% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-market-share/south-africa.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engines in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Google (92.95%), bing (6.21%), Petal Search (0.29%) in October 2026.
